result.summary: libxev is a cross-platform event-loop library; this surface is its build.zig, build.zig.zon, C header, C example programs and a website favicon. The build script only defines the Zig module, static/dynamic C libraries, tests, benchmarks and examples, and optionally generates man pages with scdoc. There are no downloads, no hidden build steps, no encoded payloads and no use of the binary asset.

findings.title: Build runs scdoc to generate man pages
findings.detail: manPages() runs the system program `scdoc` via addSystemCommand, feeding it the package's own docs/*.scd files and installing the output as man pages. This is ordinary documentation generation, gated on scdoc being present or the emit-man-pages option, and does not touch anything outside the build.

findings.title: Stale comment about libxml2
findings.detail: The comment above the dynamic library says it requires a native target 'so we can link to libxml2', yet nothing links libxml2. It looks like a stale copy-paste comment and has no effect on what is built.

findings.title: Unreferenced binary website asset
findings.detail: website/public/favicon.ico is a 25 KB binary. Nothing in build.zig or the sources shown references it. It belongs to the project website and is not compiled in or read at build time.

data_flows.what: Contents of the package's own docs/*.scd man-page sources
data_flows.to: scdoc program at build time (stdin), output installed under share/man in the build prefix
